messages:
sasha: heads up — users are hitting errors when using @redwood/inference-js in edge runtimes. stack traces point to missing sourcemaps and the package exports pointing at .cjs which fails in workers.
kevin: ugh. which version? can you paste the `require`/import error?
sasha: installed `@redwood/inference-js@2.4.0` (published yesterday). example error from Vercel Edge: `SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'export'` followed by `at file:///vercel/path/.vercel/output/functions/edge.func/.next/server/pages/api/ai.js:1:1` — but sourcemap shows nothing, it's just compiled bundle.
maria: do we have a repro? would `npm pack` locally show the broken files?
sasha: i did `npm pack` — tarball only had `dist/index.mjs` and `dist/index.cjs` but no `.map` files, and package.json `exports` only listed `./dist/index.cjs` for main condition. also `type` was missing so node resolves weirdly in edge. short: sourcemaps dropped during publish and exports are inconsistent.
kevin: maybe rollup/tsup config isn't copying maps. check `tsup` config — by default `sourcemap: true` but we exclude maps in `files` or `.npmignore`?
sasha: our package.json has: 
```json
"files": ["dist"],
"exports": {"./": "./dist/index.cjs"},
"main": "./dist/index.cjs",
"types": "./dist/index.d.ts"
```
no mention of `.map` and exports point only to cjs.
ci-bot: build pipeline log: `Packing files: 12` then `Added: dist/index.mjs, dist/index.cjs, dist/index.d.ts` — maps skipped by `npm pack` because `.npmignore` contains `*.map` (accidentally added during cleanup step).
maria: ahhh `.npmignore` removed maps during pack. That explains missing sourcemaps. still need to fix exports to support edge.
kevin: for ESM/Edge we should ship dual package exports. suggested package.json snippet: 
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/index.cjs",
    "types": "./dist/index.d.ts"
  }
},
"type": "module"
```
and include `dist/*.map` in `files`.
sasha: i can put up a quick patch: remove `*.map` from `.npmignore`, add `dist/*.map` to `files`, and update `exports` to the dual form. will also add a `prepare` script to generate bundles before publish.
maria: also add `engines`? might not be necessary but add a test against `edge-runtime` in CI (small smoke test importing the package in a worker environment).
kevin: good. also check typings path: `types` at top-level should be `./dist/index.d.ts` — confirm that is present. we saw it in tarball so ok.
sasha: quick question — do we want to keep `type: "module"`? that changes default resolution for consumers.
maria: yes, but since we provide `require` path in exports for CJS we should be safe. consumers without bundlers will still work. make sure `main` points to cjs for older node resolution too.
ci-bot: created ticket #INF-482 in releases: publish patch + rollback tag on 2.4.0 if needed.
sasha: i'm going to push a patch branch and run `npm pack` locally before creating the tag. will post results. :thumbsup:
kevin: ping me when it's packed — i'll run the edge smoke tests.
ci-bot: note: previous publish job used `npm publish --access public` inside the CI with `--no-git-tag-version` which prevented the patch script from running; might need to switch to `npm publish` after `npm run prepare` step.
maria: thanks — after fix please republish under `2.4.1` and also publish a `canary` dist-tag for early adopters. update release notes: mention sourcemaps and edge compatibility fix.
sasha: will do. attaching the failing import line for reference: 
```js
import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference-js';
// fails at runtime with Unexpected token 'export' when resolved to cjs/esm mismatch
```
kevin: sounds good. small follow-up: add a unit that asserts `npm pack` contains `.map` files in release CI so we avoid regression.
sasha: yup adding that to the pipeline. will update here when published.
ci-bot: ticket INF-482 assigned to sasha.
